mechanisms.behavior: Own manual supplies four balls and names six trough positions plus jam. Exact source initializes occupied public18-21 (TROUGH4..1), leaving16/17 and jam22 open. START13 produces repeated actual trough1 pulses while host occupancy remains static. The probe then explicitly removes rear occupancy18 and asserts shooter1; this is synthetic transfer, not measured physical ball travel. Jam policy, transfer timing, physical geometry and NC construction remain unresolved.
mechanisms.label: Trough and serve

mechanisms.behavior: Own manual and exact ELF agree on shooter1, Launch15 and actual auto-plunger2. With synthetic shooter occupancy, Launch15 produces coil2 255/0. A later additional coil2 transition follows explicit shooter departure; no isolated departure rule or physical travel/timing is inferred.
mechanisms.label: Shooter lane and automatic launcher

mechanisms.behavior: The manual distinguishes one POWER driver reference, a cabinet button leaf and fitted playfield EOS leaf. The public EOS is synthesized by PinMAME; no winding count, physical rest state, travel or tuning is asserted. Exact runtime after start observes actual power output 3 from button8 plus mirrors47/48 at 255/30/0. Callback levels/times are not physical tuning values.
mechanisms.label: Lower left flipper

mechanisms.behavior: The manual distinguishes one POWER driver reference, a cabinet button leaf and fitted playfield EOS leaf. The public EOS is synthesized by PinMAME; no winding count, physical rest state, travel or tuning is asserted. Exact runtime after start observes actual power output 4 from button10 plus mirrors45/46 at 255/30/0. Callback levels/times are not physical tuning values.
mechanisms.label: Lower right flipper

mechanisms.behavior: Own manual and exact firmware agree on combined switch6 and driver5. After start, pulse6 causes actual coil5 states194/0. This proves public causal routing, not shared physical load quantity or feedback topology.
mechanisms.label: Combined sling driver

mechanisms.behavior: Own manual and exact firmware agree on combined switch37 and driver7, with driver6 blank and no firmware route. After start, pulse37 causes actual coil7 states235/0. Shared wiring, quantities and physical timing remain unresolved.
mechanisms.label: Combined left/right pop driver

mechanisms.behavior: Own manual and exact firmware agree on bottom-pop switch38 and driver8. After start, pulse38 causes actual coil8 states255/0. This is causal routing only; physical tuning and geometry remain unresolved.
mechanisms.label: Bottom pop bumper

mechanisms.behavior: Manual page11 describes a three-bit target-bank diagnostic and Start-driven reset; pages13/17 identify the reset and left/center/right optos. Home/rest sensor levels, scoring sequence, timing and failure recovery remain unresolved.
mechanisms.label: Three-target drop bank

mechanisms.behavior: The driver table names Control Gates and page11 describes right-ramp lock testing. It does not settle the gate topology, number of controlled loads, normal position or whether the exit opto is direct feedback; no electrical relationship is invented.
mechanisms.label: Control gates and right-ramp ball lock
